title: Earliest Time to Finish One Task
description:
You are given a 2D integer array tasks where tasks[i] = [s i , t i ] . 
 
 Each [s i , t i ] in tasks represents a task with start time s i that takes t i units of time to finish. 
 
 Return the earliest time at which at least one task is finished. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: tasks = [[1,6],[2,3]] 
 
 Output: 5 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 The first task starts at time t = 1 and finishes at time 1 + 6 = 7 . The second task finishes at time 2 + 3 = 5 . You can finish one task at time 5. 

 Example 2: 

 Input: tasks = [[100,100],[100,100],[100,100]] 
 
 Output: 200 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 All three tasks finish at time 100 + 100 = 200 . 

 Constraints: 

 1 <= tasks.length <= 100 
 
 tasks[i] = [s i , t i ] 
 
 1 <= s i , t i <= 100
code: class Solution { public: int earliestTime(vector<vector<int>>& tasks){int ans=INT_MAX;for(auto&t:tasks)ans=min(ans,t[0]+t[1]);return ans;} };
